# Zizeg

> Zizeg is a native macOS Markdown editor with a rendered WYSIWYG view and a raw source view that stay genuinely in sync and are both editable, real files on disk (no vault or proprietary database), and content-safety sanitization built in by default rather than best-effort.

Built for the Markdown that piles up around AI tools: READMEs, CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md-style instruction files, specs, changelogs, and the summaries and notes AI chat tools hand back. Free to download and use for viewing/rendering any Markdown file; a one-time purchase or subscription (with a free trial) unlocks editing and export. macOS only at this time; an iPad companion app and interface localization are both planned within 6 months of this writing. Markdown scope is deliberately CommonMark + GFM (tables, task lists, strikethrough, autolinks) plus images — no math/LaTeX, no footnotes, no Mermaid diagrams, by design, not as a current gap.

Last reviewed: 2026-08-23.
